correctness.rationale: Use the actual Saha–Towers multiplication table e1e2=e4,e1e3=e5,e2e3=e6,e1e6=e7,e2e5=−e7,e3e4=e7 and anti-commutativity to identify A=V⊕Λ²V⊕Λ³V (dim 7), with product (v,a,c)(w,b,d)=(0,v∧w,v∧b−w∧a). An abelian subspace with nonzero V projection has that projection contained in a single line L=Kv because v∧w=0. For x=v+a+c with v nonzero, the centralizer consists of V components λv and Λ² components λa+v∧V, with unrestricted Λ³V, yielding a four-dimensional abelian subalgebra C(x). The ideal M=Λ²V⊕Λ³V is also maximal abelian and self-centralizing; every abelian H outside M belongs to a unique C(x), and its choice depends on one section over each L of Hom(L,Λ²(V/L)), a one-dimensional line bundle O(2) over P². Distinct C at same L meet in dimension3; different L meet in dimension2. For q odd, there are q(q²+q+1) of these plus M. Counting d-subspaces in M and then uniquely in each other maximal gives N_d=[4 d]_q+q(q²+q+1)([4 d]_q−[3 d]_q), 0<=d<=7. Over F3, independent RREF enumeration of 99,463 two-dimensional subspaces found exactly 4,693 abelian ones, agreeing with the formula; the all-field result is established by wedge relations, not the finite check. The source's Example4.6 sign convention was rechecked in its full arXiv manuscript page6.

originality.rationale: Saha–Towers (2020) explicitly gives the seven-dimensional class-three CB algebra and its multiplication table; these are prior and not novel. Their paper proves broad properties of centralizers as ideals but does not supply the projective line-bundle classification of all maximal abelian subalgebras, intersection geometry, or full subalgebra-count polynomial. A 2018 Saffarnia–Moghaddam–Rostamyari paper on centralizer counts in Lie algebras is a plausible comparison for characteristic three but its full text remained inaccessible; its available abstract does not assert this exact all-characteristic algebra and Gaussian distribution. An inaccessible plausible article is expressly recorded as originality risk rather than treated as automatic failure.
residual_risks: The 2018 centralizer-count paper is high-priority plausible overlap in characteristic three, but full text could not be retrieved because authorized access requires VPN; no whole-document NOT_COVERING claim is made.
The source example is Lie precisely in characteristic3; the broader anti-commutative non-Lie algebra in other odd characteristics must be distinguished from characteristic-zero Lie generalities.
Full proof uses char≠2 wedge/anticommutativity; q=2 enumeration in verification is only a diagnostic and is not part of the odd-characteristic theorem.
